book.aerospace.manual.page0:
Aerospace Program
FLIGHT MANUAL

Everything a new astronaut needs to reach the stars.
book.aerospace.manual.page1:
1. ROCKET
Craft one from 4 iron blocks, glass, a lightning rod and a blast furnace. It is reusable.

Hold right click with it to open Mission Control.
book.aerospace.manual.page2:
2. FUEL
Copper ingot, 2 coal or charcoal, gunpowder and blaze powder make 2 Rocket Fuel.

Trips cost:
Earth 1, Belt 1, Moon 2, Mars 3, Glacio 4, Vulcan 4.
book.aerospace.manual.page3:
3. AIR
The Moon and the Asteroid Belt have no air. Wear a Space Helmet (iron and tinted glass) or you will run out of oxygen.

Mission Control also opens from the pause menu.
book.aerospace.manual.page4:
4. GRAVITY
The Moon pulls at a sixth of Earth, Mars a third. Jump higher, fall slower.

Vulcan is heavy and hot: arrive with fire protection.
book.aerospace.manual.page5:
5. DANGER
Lost astronauts haunt the Moon, Martians roam Mars, frost wraiths guard Glacio and magma knights walk Vulcan.

Their ruins hold the best loot. Good luck.
